messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need to file a dispute for a charge on my credit card. I stayed at a Marriott hotel but when I got there, they gave me a standard double room instead. I’ve called the hotel twice and they refuse to help me. I want my money back.

{"message":"I can help file this dispute. Before I can access your account and submit the dispute I need to verify your identity (this is required to access/modify account records). Please reply with: 1) Your full name (for logging) and 2) Two of the following account verification items: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), the email on file, the phone number on file, or your mailing address. 

Also please provide the transaction details I’ll need to file the dispute: - Purchase/charge date (MM/DD/YYYY) - Transaction amount - Last 4 digits of the credit card used (if you don’t know this, tell me and I’ll try to look it up after verification) - When you first noticed the issue (MM/DD/YYYY) - Confirm you contacted the hotel (you said you called twice — please confirm true/false)

Finally, please confirm these dispute choices: - Dispute reason: I recommend “goods_services_not_as_described” (room different than booked). If you prefer a different reason, say which from: unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging, refund_never_processed. - Resolution requested: choose one of full_refund, partial_refund, reversal_of_charge (if partial, state the amount).

Note: For “goods/services not as described” disputes, provisional (temporary) credit is generally NOT eligible under our guidelines, so you may not receive provisional credit while we investigate. The investigation can take up to several weeks (typically up to 45 days). If you’d like me to proceed after verification, tell me “Proceed to file dispute” in your next reply and I’ll continue."}
